observations:
All conceptual domains in Torah #164 are fully represented by the four proposed packages in torah_164_packages.json. No independent bechina domain of 3+ concepts was found that stands structurally separate from those packages.

The four packages map directly to the teaching's four-role structure:

  Package 1 (צַדִּיק וְרוֹפֵא הַנְּפָשׁוֹת, good) — The master healer who knows the real medicine: the Tzaddik/talmid-chacham.
  Package 2 (תּוֹרָה וּרְפוּאָה, good) — Torah itself as healing substance, in its inner and outer dimensions: Torah, pnimiyut, sam chaim, refuah gnuza.
  Package 3 (לְבוּשׁ וְסִפּוּרֵי מַעֲשִׂיּוֹת, neutral) — The garment/wrapping medium: sipurei ma'asiot, sipurei dvarim, levush, eruv, other Torah words.
  Package 4 (הַחוֹלֶה וּמִי שֶׁלֹּא זָכָה, evil) — The unready receiver: the sick patient, the one who did not merit, Torah-as-poison.

The good/evil mirror structure in Torah #164:
  Package 2 (good pole of Torah) has an exact evil mirror within Package 4: סַם חַיִּים (Package 2) mirrors סַם הַמָּוֶת (Package 4). Torah is the same substance — but it bifurcates based on the receiver's readiness. This is a rare case where the mirror is internal to a node (Torah) rather than between two separate concept clusters: the very same Torah IS healing-elixir for the worthy, and IS death-poison for the unworthy. The teaching's argument is precisely that this bifurcation is why the garment (Package 3) is necessary — it allows the healing of Torah to reach the sick receiver (Package 4) through the mediation of the Tzaddik healer (Package 1).

No cross-Torah new concept family was identified. The teaching is thematically self-contained. All concepts cluster naturally into the four packages above.

The eitza (cause-effect) flow between packages:
  [Pkg 1: Tzaddik] → prescribes garment → [Pkg 3: levush/stories] → delivers → [Pkg 2: inner Torah/healing] → reaches → [Pkg 4: sick receiver, transformed]
  Without [Pkg 3], [Pkg 2] + [Pkg 4] = death (sam mavet). With [Pkg 3] mediating, [Pkg 4]'s receiver can safely absorb [Pkg 2]'s healing.
